zh-CN.name: 口播剪辑师
zh-CN.summary: 在本机剪辑竖屏口播，交付 MP4、字幕和封面。需本机 FFmpeg、离线转写工具及可用的 DesireCore 算力。
zh-CN.description: 以原声和论述为主线，按时间戳剪去空镜与冗余停顿，制作单行短句字幕、重点词标黄和讲解动效。交付 MP4、SRT、封面与验收说明。可按用户给定的本机手册工作。需另行准备 FFmpeg、ffprobe、离线转写工具、中文字体和具备工具调用能力的 DesireCore 算力。依赖各按自身条款使用，算力费用另计。

en-US.name: Talking-Head Editor
en-US.summary: Edit vertical talking-head footage locally. Requires FFmpeg, offline transcription and configured DesireCore compute.
en-US.description: Trim dead air against source timestamps, retain the speaker's voice and meaning, and add single-line captions, highlighted keywords and explanatory motion. Deliver an MP4, SRT, cover and verification note. Can follow an optional local playbook. Separately provide FFmpeg, ffprobe, offline transcription, appropriate fonts and a tool-capable DesireCore model. Dependencies have their own terms and model costs are separate.

requirements.value: Provide FFmpeg and ffprobe with appropriate decoder, encoder and caption filters, an offline ASR runtime and model, and local fonts. An optional playbook or renderer may have additional dependencies.

Use an authorized local workspace and tool-capable DesireCore compute. Tools, models, fonts and optional renderers have independent licenses and may have separate costs. Credentials and preapproved permissions are not included.
